#2932 part 2, re-recorded on the bytes merged with main (part 1 landed as #3091; this record took main's bindings in the merge, and the earlier part 2 notes for this page remain in the notes files of 20261001). The Claude adapter hands the SDK a spawnClaudeCodeProcess whose stdout passes through a tap recording each can_use_tool request's reason type, classifier_approvable, reason code and requires_user_interaction by request_id; canUseTool takes the record by requestId, publishes it as claudeAsk, and treats a missing record as an escalation. Final-round corrections checked on the merged page: gap (i) now covers any permissions.ask rule on the chain or on one part whenever the chain arrives as subcommandResults, including a rule written for the whole chain (the whole-exact capture, now the sixth plain case in fixtures/claude-2.1.278-chained-bash-asks.json and replayed through the adapter under a Bash grant); the 'shell asks always carry a reason type' claim is replaced by what the captures show (an ordinary Bash ask carries other; a Bash path-check ask carries a blocked path and no type and prompts on both counts); 'captured from live turns' is scoped to gaps (i) and (ii) and the two guarantees, with gap (iii) and the PowerShell warning list marked as read in the engine's code. Rechecked the rest against claudeAskEscalates and the shared and adapter tests after the merge: reason types, classifier_approvable, decision_reason_code, PowerShell always escalating, the Bash-only plain chain, the fail-closed missing record, the 256-record and 8 MiB bounds, replay only on the initialize response, and conflicting records reading as missing. Main's side of the merge changed four lines of this page's part 1 text, which read correctly beside the part 2 section.
